topic: The longest mountain range is underwater
script: Earth's longest mountain range is almost entirely underwater. The mid-ocean ridge winds around the planet for about 65,000 kilometers. Along it, the sea floor slowly pulls apart and new crust forms. Hot rock rising there feeds many hydrothermal vents. In Iceland, the ridge rises above the sea, and you can walk through its rift valley. Most of the ridge lies more than 2 kilometers below the waves.
